context:
Decision gate (owner): approve this offer before any upstream contact.

Verification rubric: (1) the reduced change applies to current upstream main; (2) its dialect tests pass on the real engine; (3) the fork's downstream contract tests pass after the patches.json edit.

Guardrails: no pull request, issue or comment on tobymao/sqlglot until the owner approves this specific offer in this item's context; the offered change must be the fork patch reduced to upstream-only behaviour; the patch stays carried in patches.json until upstream merges and a refresh retires it with equivalence evidence.

Upstream rules (tobymao/sqlglot AGENTS.md): Conventional Commits title ending with the agent model ([CLAUDE], [CODEX]); minimal scope; tests in tests/dialects that run on the real engine; no fork-only behaviour or benchbox package references.

Owner approval 2026-11-21 (Joe Harris, choice dialog): approved for upstream offer to tobymao/sqlglot.

2026-11-21: offered as https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9309 with fork commit 4ba0d235 (branch upstream/bigquery-window-nulls-ordering, built on upstream main 089891f2). Reduced change = fork patch unchanged; applies cleanly to upstream main. Verified on real BigQuery (project benchbox-testing): upstream main's output is rejected in 9 of 11 queries ('NULLS LAST not supported with ascending sort order in RANGE clauses of analytic functions.'), the patched output in 0 of 11; patched rows match DuckDB for 10 of 10 queries over data with NULL keys. tests.dialects.test_bigquery passes (74 tests); the full upstream suite (1770 tests) has only the two environment errors that base also has (test_lazy_load, test_sqlglotc); no new ruff findings. Filed as an issue because upstream accepts pull requests only from collaborators. Fork patches.json moves the entry to offered in branch chore/record-bigquery-duckdb-offers. Next: when upstream fixes the issue, a refresh retires the patch with equivalence evidence; until then it stays carried.
